newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem up on low price, not on factory plans.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem up on low price, not on factory plans.

text.p: Share prices in Hungarian chemicals firm Borsodchem rose more than three percent in early trading on Tuesday but traders said low prices rather than news about its planned new factories behind the gains.
Borsodchem opened at 6,000 forints, slightly above Monday's close of 5,980 forints. After heavy fluctuations in early trade, it traded at 6,200 forints at 1121 GMT.

"I would not explain Borsodchem's rise by the news about the factory but rather by the fact that Borsodchem's price was cheap," one trader said. "Investors rediscovered Borsodchem shares after its recent price falls."

Borsodchem said on Monday Austria's Krems Chemie AG would build a synthetic resin plant in Hungary, to use the excess output of a formaldehyde plant which Krems plans to build jointly with Borsodchem.
